item.title: But Not For You
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Dr.Opah
  • 発売日: 2019-07-07
  • スコア: 7.409999999999999/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: バット・ノット・フォー・ユー
  • 英語名: But Not For You

あらすじ

Momo, our main character, has a crush on his senior in the literature club.

Burdened by unrequited love and insecurities about being a guy, one day, he stumbles into a world where he’s a girl.

Confused yet gradually embracing his new identity, he eventually confronts the reason for his arrival in this world and the mystery surrounding his senior.

item.title: Dice Game
item.description:

  • ブランド: Dr.Opah
  • 発売日: 2016-04-12
  • スコア: 6.49/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ダイスゲーム
  • 英語名: Dice Game

あらすじ

In a university lab, nine men and women gather to play a game known as “The Matchmaking Game.”

The rules are simple.

Roll the dice in turn and follow the instructions that come up.

As the game unfolds, hidden feelings spill out one after the other.
